pages.title: New Orleans cruise ship collision: All passengers rescued in 'miracle on the Mississippi' British Broadcasting Corporation British Broadcasting Corporation
pages.description: The collision leaves 32 people in hospital with non-critical injuries, but no-one unaccounted for.
pages.text: New Orleans cruise ship collision: All passengers rescued in 'miracle on the Mississippi' Skip to content Site search Home News Sport Business Technology Health Culture Arts Travel Earth Audio Video Live Documentaries Weather Newsletters Watch Live 'Miracle on Mississippi' - All passengers rescued after New Orleans cruise ship collision 3 days ago Share Save Add as preferred on Google Ana Faguy Watch: Cruise ship seen sinking after collision with cargo ship in New Orleans Some 130 people on a cruise ship docked in New Orleans have been rescued after it was struck by a tanker. The cruise ship, American Heritage, was left lying on its side in the Mississippi River after it was hit by the cargo vessel Atlantic Asphalt. The collision left 32 people from the stricken riverboat in hospital with non-critical injuries, but no-one unaccounted for. Officials hailed it as a "miracle on the Mississippi". The exact cause of the crash remains under investigation, but US Coast Guard Capt Melanie Burnham said: "There seems to be some type of a loss of steering." New Orleans Mayor Helena Moreno told a news conference on Friday that all credit in the rescue effort should go to first responders who "literally jumped right in to help". "We have zero people unaccounted for, which truly is a miracle on the Mississippi," Moreno said. Calls about the collision began around 13:30 EST (18:30 GMT) on Friday, when people began trying to help passengers escape the boat as it took on water, Port of New Orleans chief Melanie Montroll told the news conference. Lawmakers in the New York state assembly approved legislation on Tuesday that will allow MMA events to take place in New York, making it the 50th and final state to legalize and regulate the sport. The bill clears the path for the Ultimate Fighting Championship, the sport’s leading promoter, to hold events at Madison Square Garden and other venues in the state. The final floor vote was 113 to 25, having cleared three committees earlier in the day. The yes total well exceeded the 76 required for passage. pages.text: Newfound Fossil Octopus and Squid Were Giants | National Geographic Photo by fir0002, GFDL 1.2. A giant squid in a block of ice at Australia's Melbourne Aquarium. SCIENCE LAELAPS Newfound Fossil Octopus and Squid Were Giants By Riley Black Published March 10, 2015 • 4 min read A good fossil squid is hard to find. The invertebrates are too squishy to leave much behind, and only in truly exceptional circumstances do paleontologists get to see much more than the chitinous supports the cephalopods kept on the inside. Octopus are even more confounding. Without any remnants of an internal shell, the eight-armed quick-change artists are like prehistoric ghosts. But do not despair. The jaws of ancient coleoids give us reason for hope, and have just revealed a pair of prehistoric cephalopods that may have rivaled today’s ocean giants in size. Described by Kazushige Tanabe and colleagues in Acta Palaeontologica Polonica , the two lower jaws were found in roughly 80 million year old rock around Hokkaido, Japan’s Haboro-futamata Dam. Both were preserved in three-dimensional detail, providing Tanabe and coworkers with enough anatomical clues to figure out that they were left behind by previously-unknown species. Octopus and squid beaks can be very informative fossils. That’s because marine biologists have spent a great deal of time studying the chitinous beaks of modern cephalopods. (Not much more than beaks and hooks are left in the guts of squid-eating whales, for example.) Close nicofr77's Diary À portée de train : une carte des boucles vélo accessibles en train, depuis 60 villes Posted by nicofr77 on 2 October 2026 in French (Français) . Last updated on 4 October 2026. Je publie sur Tisseur de Voies, le site où je calcule des boucles vélo avec retour en train, une carte qui répond à une question simple : depuis ma ville, jusqu’où puis-je partir à vélo en prenant un seul train ? On choisit une ville parmi 60 et une durée de train aller, de 0 à 4 heures. La carte montre en rose les véloroutes des boucles qu’on peut rejoindre, et en bleu les gares atteintes, plus foncées quand elles sont proches. Ici, Paris avec une heure de train : 1 763 boucles, contre 323 qui partent des gares parisiennes. Une boucle, c’est un itinéraire à vélo d’une gare à une autre sur des véloroutes balisées, avec un train pour rentrer. Elle compte dès qu’un train aller atteint l’une de ses gares dans la durée choisie. Un classement des 60 villes accompagne la carte : Paris, Strasbourg et Lille en tête, Brest et Quimper en queue. Les véloroutes viennent d’OpenStreetMap et du référentiel national des véloroutes, le fond de carte d’OpenStreetMap. Les durées sortent des horaires publiés en open data par la SNCF, Île-de-France Mobilités, la Région Sud et les Chemins de fer de la Corse : pour chaque trajet, la durée médiane de la ligne la plus rapide qui circule au moins une fois par jour. Seuls les trains sans changement comptent.

The ruling, issued by the Tripoli-based institution, states that the US sportswear giant was named after the Greek goddess of victory and that its famous swoosh logo was inspired by her wings. It argued that wearing clothing displaying the logo amounted to promoting symbols associated "with polytheism," or the worship of more than one god. Libya is home to the ancient Greek city of Cyrene, where archaeological remains include a statue of the Greek goddess of the same name. The religious committee also accused Nike of supporting Israel and called for a boycott of companies that back the country. It referred to a statement issued by its Council for Research and Sharia Studies on 5 November 2023, urging Muslims to boycott Western companies it considers supportive of Israel during the war in Gaza. What is NIST on a Chip? NIST has embarked on a revolutionary program that will bring cutting-edge measurement-science technology and expertise from our labs directly to users in commerce, medicine, defense and academia. We are developing a suite of inherently accurate measurement technologies that operate according to the precise, time-tested principles of quantum physics. The ultimate goal of NIST on a Chip technology is for it to be deployed nearly anywhere and anytime, without the need for NIST’s traditional measurement services. We are seeking partnerships with the U.S. private sector and other government agencies to bring these technologies to commercial reality and unleash new capabilities for American innovation. If perfected, the technology could help recoup some of the recoverable heat energy that is wasted in the U.S. at a rate of about $100 billion each year. The new fabrication technique — developed by NIST researcher Kris Bertness and her collaborators — involves depositing hundreds of thousands of microscopic columns of gallium nitride atop a silicon wafer. Layers of silicon are then removed from the underside of the wafer until only a thin sheet of the material remains. No FEAR Act Data The Notification and Federal Employee Anti-discrimination and Retaliation Act of 2002 ( No FEAR Act, P.L. 107-174 ) increases accountability of Federal agencies for acts of discrimination or reprisal against employees resulting from whistleblower complaints, and complaints before the Merit Systems Protection Board and the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission. The No FEAR Act requires each Federal agency to publicly post summary statistical data relating to equal employment opportunity complaints filed against the agency on a quarterly basis during each fiscal year, and cumulative fiscal year end data for the five preceding years. For additional information, please contact the Office of Equal Employment Opportunity at (202) 586-2218 or at civilrights@hq.doe.gov . Close no87xis's Diary OSM → CDR/DWG: зачем дизайнерам и проектировщикам данные OSM Posted by no87xis on 27 July 2026 in Russian (Русский) . Привет! Я несколько лет делаю сервис, который выгружает данные OSM в форматы, живущие за пределами ГИС-мира: CorelDRAW (CDR), AutoCAD (DWG/DXF), SVG для иллюстраторов, STL для 3D-печати. Оказалось, самая благодарная аудитория данных OSM — вовсе не картографы: это дизайнеры вывесок, которым нужна карта района в кривых; проектировщики, которым нужна подложка в DWG; мастера лазерной гравировки, режущие карты городов по DXF. Главная боль, которую пришлось решать, — сохранить СЛОИ: чтобы дороги, здания и вода приезжали в CorelDRAW отдельными редактируемыми слоями, а не одной свалкой кривых. Устроено это так: каждый экспорт собирается из тех же тематических групп, которыми думает сам OSM, — дороги, здания, вода, растительность, землепользование, точки интереса. Внутри файла каждая группа становится отдельным именованным слоем целевой программы: слой можно скрыть, перекрасить или удалить одним движением, не выбирая объекты поштучно. Подписи улиц тоже живут отдельным слоем — дизайнеру вывески они обычно нужны, мастеру гравировки почти никогда. Вторая боль — граница. pages.description: In 75 years, the United Nations, its specialised agencies, related agencies, funds, programmes and staff were awarded the prestigious Nobel Peace Prize twelve times.
pages.text: Nobel Peace Prize AR | الأمم المتحدة Skip to main content الأمم المتحدة وجائزة نوبل للسلام الأمم المتحدة وجائزة نوبل للسلام استلهم ألفريد نوبل وصيته التي حررها عام 1895 من إيمانه بوحدة الأسرة الإنسانية. ونصّت الوصية على أن تُمنح جائزة نوبل للسلام للشخص الذي يبذل أكبر جهد في سبيل «تعزيز الأخوّة بين الأمم، وإلغاء الجيوش الدائمة أو تقليصها، وعقد مؤتمرات السلام وتشجيعها». مُنحت جائزة نوبل للسلام المرموقة 13 مرة للأمم المتحدة و وكالاتها المتخصصة وصناديقها وبرامجها ، والمنظمات المرتبطة بها، ولمسؤولين حاليين وسابقين في المنظمة. وقد نالت المفوضية السامية للأمم المتحدة لشؤون اللاجئين هذه الجائزة مرتين، في عامي 1954 و 1981 . وكرّمت لجنة نوبل النرويجية أيضًا أمينين عامين للأمم المتحدة، هما كوفي عنان و داغ همرشولد ، تقديرًا لجهودهما. وعقب فوزه بالجائزة مناصفة مع الأمم المتحدة عام 2001، أعرب الأمين العام كوفي عنان، في كلمة وجهها إلى موظفي المنظمة، عن أمله في أن «تدفعنا هذه الجائزة إلى المضي قدمًا، وتشجعنا جميعًا على النهوض بمهامنا بعزيمة أشد». «على مدى مئة عام، سعت لجنة نوبل النرويجية إلى توطيد التعاون المنظّم بين الدول. وقد أتاحت نهاية الحرب الباردة للأمم المتحدة أخيرًا أن تنهض على نحو أكمل بالدور الذي أُنشئت من أجله. وتقف المنظمة اليوم في طليعة الجهود الرامية إلى تحقيق السلام والأمن في العالم، وفي صدارة التعبئة الدولية لمواجهة التحديات الاقتصادية والاجتماعية والبيئية التي تواجه العالم... وتود لجنة نوبل النرويجية، في عامها المئوي، أن تعلن أن الطريق الوحيد القائم على التفاوض لتحقيق السلام والتعاون على الصعيد العالمي يمر عبر الأمم المتحدة». معهد نوبل النرويجي أوسلو، 12 تشرين الأول/أكتوبر 2001 الحائزون على جائزة نوبل من الأمم المتحدة 2026 - نافانيثيم بيلاي مُنحت جائزة نوبل للسلام لعام 202

pages.description: Paula Pugh says she travelled to Italy in September to celebrate her husband's birthday.
pages.text: Norfolk holidaymaker says visa error blocked entry to Italy Skip to content Site search Home News Sport Business Technology Health Culture Arts Travel Earth Audio Video Live Documentaries Weather Newsletters Watch Live Holidaymaker says visa error blocked entry to Italy 1 hour ago Share Save Add as preferred on Google Owen Sennitt Norfolk Paula Pugh Paula Pugh, pictured with her husband Andy, was refused entry into Italy A holidaymaker said she believed she was refused entry at the Italian border due to a computer error that recorded her as having overstayed a visa. Paula Pugh, 61, from Swaffham, Norfolk, travelled from Stansted Airport to Calabria in southern Italy for a five-day holiday to celebrate her husband's birthday in September. After arriving she was told she had exceeded her 90-day visa-free allowance to the Schengen area and was put on a return flight, but Pugh said this was a database error and that she had only spent 22 days in the area. The European Commission said it is the responsibility of individual countries to correct any errors. The 61-year-old said the experience made her feel "like a criminal", but so far she has been unable to identify the source of the error. Her experience also cost her hundreds of pounds after she had to pay for her return flight back to the UK and she lost money she had already spent on the holiday. Pugh and her husband arrived at Reggio Calabria Airport at 12:40 BST but was denied entry. pages.text: North Dakota Badlands 2026: When to visit, where to stay, and what to do | National Geographic TRAVEL BEST OF THE WORLD Why you should visit the rugged North Dakota Badlands in 2026 Discover the best seasons to visit, where to stay near Theodore Roosevelt National Park, and how to explore this otherworldly landscape. The Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library is set to open in July 2026 outside Medora, North Dakota. Photograph by Image Professionals GmbH, Alamy Stock Photo By Stephanie Pearson Published October 21, 2025 Theodore Roosevelt first traveled to the Badlands on a hunting trip in 1883. He was so taken by the otherworldly landscape of pastel buttes, trilling meadowlarks, and disappearing bison, that he returned in 1884 to grieve the simultaneous deaths of his wife and mother, raising cattle and working on the wild frontier for almost three years. Its “desolate, grim beauty” so changed Roosevelt that he famously wrote, “I would not have been president had it not been for my experience in North Dakota .” Opening on July 4, 2026, the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library celebrates the Badlands as much as it does the 26th president. Designed by Norwegian architectural firm Snøhetta, the state-of-the-art, sustainable library sits high on a lonely butte outside of Medora, a military camp turned frontier town named after a French nobleman’s wife. The 93,000-square-foot library disappears into its surroundings, camouflaged by a living roof sprouting native plants, part of a 1.3-mile walking trail that provides sweeping views toward the national park. The district includes the upper Colorado River corridor along with the White and Yampa rivers. It is home to some of the largest deer and elk herds in the area, along with pronghorn, bighorn sheep and a wide variety of other wildlife. The Northwest District contains the majority of the Colorado range of the Greater Sage Grouse. pages.description: An easy way for Armed Forces personnel or their families to let IRS know they're in a combat zone.
pages.text: Notifying the IRS by Email about Combat Zone Service | Internal Revenue Service Skip to main content Notifying the IRS by Email about Combat Zone Service More In News Working Families Tax Cuts News releases Tax relief in disaster situations Topics in the news Fact sheets IRS statements and announcements IRS Tax Tips IRS guidance Media center Tax articles to share Posters to share Working with the Department of Defense, the Internal Revenue Service identifies taxpayers who are serving in a combat zone to suspend compliance actions, such as audits or enforced collections, until 180 days after the taxpayer has left the zone. Taxpayers, including civilian taxpayers working with U.S. Armed Forces, qualifying for such combat zone relief may also notify the IRS directly of their status through combatzone@irs.gov . They should provide their name, stateside address, date of birth, and the date of deployment to the combat zone. Taxpayers should also include any official document that indicates their area or military operation. Civilians usually provide a Letter of Authorization or a letter from their employer. However, letters from the military that state the taxpayer served in a tax-free zone or Combat Zone Tax Exclusion (CZTE) area are acceptable. Do not include any Social Security numbers in an email. The taxpayer, taxpayer's spouse, or an authorized agent or representative may make this notification. The IRS cannot provide tax account information by email. On Thursday, Huang stepped down from the US chip giant after admitting he had an affair. He was reportedly involved with a woman named Alice Huang, who ran Singaporean data centre company Megaspeed, a major buyer of Nvidia's chips. For decades, Singapore has painstakingly cultivated a reputation as an open, business-friendly economy offering easy access to both the US and Chinese markets. With the AI boom, it has become a major hub for the trade of high-end semiconductor chips in recent years. Singapore was the second-largest billing centre globally last year for Nvidia, accounting for nearly a fifth of what the US chip giant earns. It describes occupations in terms of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required as well as how the work is performed in terms of tasks, work activities, and other descriptors. O*NET database Content Model Every occupation requires a different mix of knowledge, skills, and abilities, and is performed using a variety of activities and tasks. These distinguishing characteristics, or "descriptors", of an occupation are collected, codified, and described by the O*NET Content Model . This hierarchical model starts with six domains (or categories), describing the day-to-day aspects of the job and the qualifications and interests of the typical worker. The model includes nearly 277 descriptors collected by the O*NET program, along with other occupational data collected by other federal agencies such as the Bureau of Labor Statistics . pages.text: Office buildings emptied out but are filling up again - as homes Skip to content Site search Home News Sport Business Technology Health Culture Arts Travel Earth Audio Video Live Documentaries Weather Newsletters Watch Live Office buildings emptied out but are filling up again - as homes 6 days ago Share Save Add as preferred on Google John Laurenson Business reporter, Paris Evidence Paris Le Diamant office building is to close and be converted into apartments When Roland Cubin walks you round what will eventually be a new Parisian apartment you have to use your imagination. "Here you will be in the kitchen, and here is the bathroom," says the deputy CEO of French real estate company Groupama Immobilier. It all sounds appealing, an upmarket flat in the west of Paris, but presently the space doesn't look like one at all. That's because it's currently a corner of one floor of a nine-storey office building called Le Diamant, where 1,800 people work. Groupama Immobilier intends to convert the entire building into apartments. It should be the first of many such office-to-apartments conversions in the surrounding area.
